feature_notes:
Completes assigned M2 core value/string/date/formula read acceptance with test consolidation and explicit evidence. New usable APIs include native Windows/macOS host-memory probes, bounded owned theme palettes/font schemes, optional owned formula cm/vm references, concurrency-aware Auto allowances and exact arbitrary decimal charset/theme/indexed style identities across shared catalogs/codecs. Streaming/materialized/SST policies remain explicit; low-memory Auto can spill shared strings to bounded data/index stores and clean owned temporary files.

The Python adapter exposes canonical resource limits, SST RAM/Auto/disk placement, cache/temp limits and Auto parameters without duplicating strategy logic. Python publication is maintained separately and pins this core. Core MSRV stays 1.88; Python wheels use latest stable Rust.

Test consolidation retains all forty temporal replacement combinations in two batched Python cases and adds three batched resource tests. Original licensed upstream test bodies are unchanged. Core has 267 passing collected tests plus the facade doc test; stable coverage reports 87.58% lines and 84.73% regions with explicit exclusions/embedded-test scope. Branch instrumentation was not collected, and coverage is not a completion percentage.

Linux/Windows/macOS Rust 1.88 default and native-zlib checks and latest-stable quality checks pass in CI 37293401537. Representative exact style creation remains faster/lower-RSS than openpyxl in measured workloads, with +2.1%/-1.8% observed time differences versus the prior native baseline and 488 additional managed catalog bytes. Concurrent two-sheet SST evidence records RAM/disk/time/RSS tradeoffs and cleanup; parallelism duplicates stores and is not universally faster.

M2 closes only its assigned core acceptance. Full loaded structural/style mutations, feature graphs, complete tokenizer/proxies and full openpyxl API coverage remain M4-M7/adapter work. Windows/macOS host probes do not discover private job/process constraints: constrained callers must use explicit budgets or available_bytes. Resource allowances are not hard whole-process RSS caps. Typed theme transforms and metadata graph creation/editing reject Unsupported; original opaque preservation remains separate. See docs/validation/alpha5-m2-acceptance.md, ADRs 0050-0054 and reproducible raw measurements.
